Commentary.Commentary: We're done with all the games from Group B. Scotland and Bangladesh have booked their place in the Super 12. On Friday, at 2 pm local (10 am GMT), it will be a do-or-die game between Namibia and Ireland to decide the second team to qualify from Group A. We will have another contest in the evening at 6 pm local (2 pm GMT) between Sri Lanka and the Netherlands but there isn't much riding on that game in terms of qualification. Do join us for all the action. Cheers!

Kyle Coetzer, the winning captain of Scotland, says it's a great feeling. He applauds the efforts of Oman and also the management for organizing this stage of the tournament. He adds that this win is huge and will help the game grow in Scotland. Adds that this team is all about togetherness and going through thick and thin and learning from mistakes. Further states that going into the next round, the challenge will be tough but there is no reason to fear anyone and they will go into every game with hope. Tells that bowling has been good and they would like someone to get a big score. Signs off by saying that they will find some time to celebrate tonight.

Zeeshan Maqsood, the skipper of Oman, says that they have lost a chance but they will come back stronger. Adds that they were not able to put a good total on the board and also bowled too short. Further says that they didn't get the breakthroughs. States that overall they are happy with how the Oman boys have performed. Adds that Jatinder Singh, unfortunately, got out and when your in-form batsman gets out cheaply in a big match, it puts pressure on others. Adds that he is sorry that they did not deliver but they are happy overall and are looking forward to the series against Namibia.

Josh Davey (4-0-25-3) is the Man of the Match. Says that the boys are absolutely buzzing and what a day it is for Scottish cricket. Adds that they do have an early flight to catch but there will be some celebrations tonight. Mentions that the catches did go to hand today and that bit of luck is needed. Also adds that T20 is all about momentum which they have and will be looking to take it forward and pull off some upsets as they have done in the past.
Presentation time...

At the halfway mark, when the equation was very simple, Kyle Coetzer got bowled and it gave Oman a slight opening. There was a quiet period after the Drinks break where Oman gave away only 11 runs in 3 overs but the required rate never bothered Scotland. A couple of biggies from the bat of Richie Berrington followed next and settled things well for the Scottish team. They eventually crossed the line with 3 overs to spare. Heartbreak for Oman but they did well to reach this stage. They got outplayed here but in the other two games, Oman left a big impact.

Chasing a target of 123, Scotland only needed to bat sensibly and concentrate on building partnerships. Their openers provided them with a good platform with George Munsey playing some attractive shots. After his departure, Kyle Coetzer took things under his control and formed another partnership for the second wicket. The Scottish skipper returned to form in this crucial game and put his side in a winning position.

A clinical victory for Scotland and they have booked their place in the Super 12. They were exceptional with the ball to restrict Oman to a below-par total and then their batters made short work of the target in front of them. What a day for Scottish cricket as they have qualified for the Super 12 for the first time! Scotland will go to Group 2 where they will compete with teams like India, Pakistan, New Zealand and Afghanistan.
SIX! Richie Berrington finishes off in style! A length ball, around off, Richie Berrington pulls it high and all the way over mid-wicket for a maximum. SCOTLAND WIN BY 8 WICKETS!
FOUR! Just a maximum away now! Short ball, around leg, Richie Berrington pulls it towards cow corner for a boundary.
Fuller this time, on middle and leg, Matthew Cross gets it away from the inside half of his blade towards fine leg for a single.
Full toss, on the pads, Richie Berrington whips it towards cow corner for a single.
Mohammad Nadeem delivers this on a length again, on the pads, Matthew Cross clips it to the deep square leg region for a single.
Mohammad Nadeem (1-0-9-0) is brought back into the attack.
On a length, on off, Matthew Cross hits it back to the bowler.
Full and wide outside off, Richie Berrington looks to get a bat on that one but misses. 13 needed off 24 balls.
Slower length ball, around off, Richie Berrington tries to heave it across the line but misses.
WIDE! Short ball, outside off, Richie Berrington looks to upper-cut it but misses. Wide called for height.
Full, on off, Richie Berrington hits this hard towards the extra cover fielder in the ring,
Back of a length, outside off, Cross steers it towards point for another single.
Fuller, on off, Cross pushes it to the cover fielder.
Shorter length, on off, Richie Berrington pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Bilal Khan (2-0-12-0) is back into the attack.
Fuller, slower, Richie Berrington drills it to long off for another single.
Fuller, on off, Cross drives it to long off for a single.
Flat again shorter, Matthew Cross slaps it  hard towards wide long on for a couple.
Flatter, outside off, Cross cuts it to point. Dot ball.
Fuller, outside off, Richie Berrington slaps it to extra cover for a single.
Shorter, outside off, Matthew Cross gets deep in his crease and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Aqib Ilyas (1-0-8-0) is back into the attack.
SIX! Huge over for Scotland! 15 coming off it. A full ball, on off. Richie Berrington shuffles across and tonks it over long off for a biggie. 22 needed in 36 balls.
Short and on off, Cross uses the depth of his crease and pulls it to long on for a run.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.

SIX! HAMMERED! This was full and on middle, Richie Berrington clears his front leg and smokes it straight down the ground for a biggie. His 50th six in this format and will release the pressure that had started to build.
This time he mistimes his sweep and the ball lobs back on the pitch. The keeper tries his best to run out the batter but Richie is back safely.
Scotland are playing on the leg side nicely! Full and on middle, swept to short fine leg for a single.
4 coming off the over! Bowls it full, very full on middle, Richie Berrington digs it out back to the bowler. A quiet phase for Scotland at the moment, 37 needed in 42 balls.
Tossed up on middle, Matthew Cross sweeps it to square leg for another single.
Full and on off, driven nicely but straight to cover.
Loopy ball, outside off. Richie Berrington drags it to mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, drilled down to long on for a single.
Just over backward point! A flatter ball, on off, Richie Berrington backs away and looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge. The ball lobs over the leaping fielder and drops safely. Single.
On middle and leg again, Matthew Cross sweeps it to fine leg for a couple. Good two tidy overs from Oman here. But they need wickets here.

Oman have taken the review for an LBW decision. UltraEdge shows that the ball did not take the bat or the glove on the way. Ball Tracker shows that the ball is going over the middle stump and hence, the onfield decision of NOT OUT is upheld.

NOT OUT! Cross is safe. That looked not out even to the naked eye. Khawar Ali delivers this on middle and leg, Matthew Cross goes for the sweep but misses. Gets hit on the pads. Oman appeal but the umpire doesn't respond. They take a review but the Ball Tracker shows that it is missing the stumps. No damage is done.
Fuller, on off, Matthew Cross drives it to short cover. Dot ball.
Quicker, on the pads, Richie Berrington works it to short fine leg for a quick single.
A slip has been put in place now.
Slower, wider, outside off, Richie Berrington slashes at that but misses.
Tossed up, on middle, Matthew Cross sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller, on off again, Matthew Cross punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Quicker, fuller, outside off, Cross looks to drive but misses.
Fuller, on off, Richie pushes it to long off for a single,
On off, this time, Richie Berrington punches it to the fielder at short extra cover.
Shorter, slower, Richie Berrington pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter, on the pads, Matthew Cross clips it to deep square leg for a single.

DRINKS! A well-set Kyle Coetzer departs right at the stroke of the Drinks break. It should just be a minor blip for Scotland as they are breezing through in this run chase and still have 8 wickets in hand. With not many runs on the board, the Oman bowlers have conceded way too many boundaries and as a result, the hosts are on the back foot. Scotland just require 48 more runs off 60 balls. Also, Richie Berrington walks in and Zeeshan Maqsood (1-0-12-0) is back into the attack.

OUT! TIMBER! Much-needed one and Khawar Ali has done the magic here! Scotland lose the wicket at the stroke of Drinks. This was full and skidding through, around leg. Kyle Coetzer prods to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball ricochets away onto the stumps. Skipper goes for 41 but has put his team in a strong position.
Again shuffles across and paddles this full ball to short fine leg for another single.
Angles a full ball, on middle, it's pushed back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, outside off. Kyle smashes it to long off for one more.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Cross shuffles across and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
This one turns away after landing on middle. Cross solidly defends it to covers.
On a length, on off, punched to mid off. 51 needed in 66 balls.
SIX! That has come out from the middle! A length ball, on middle. Kyle Coetzer stands tall and picks it up nicely as he pulls it all the way over mid-wicket for a maximum.

Beautiful delivery! A length ball, nipping back in, around middle and leg. Kyle Coetzer looks to play it on the leg side but misses and gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball whizzes past over the leg pole. The keeper collects, decides to appeal but then holds back. He passes on the message to the bowler that there was no wood and Mohammad Nadeem returns to his mark.
This one jags back in, on a length around off. Matthew Cross is taken by surprise as he looks to defend. Gets an inside edge to the fine leg region. A single.
A full toss, angling down, on the pads. Kyle Coetzer whips it to deep square leg for one run.
Mohammad Nadeem is now brought into the attack.
Full and on middle, Cross eases it down to long on for a single.
Flatter this time, Matthew Cross gets back and works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 5 singles from the over, that's all they need to do.
Fuller length, outside off, Kyle Coetzer pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Half-tracker again, Matthew Cross pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter again, on the stumps, Kyle Coetzer pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Shorter length, outside off, Kyle Coetzer hits this hard but straight to the short cover fielder.
Tossed up, on off, Matthew Cross checks his drive towards sweeper cover for a single.
Khawar Ali comes into the attack for the first time today.
FOUR! Width and smashed! Full, outside off, Kyle Coetzer slashes at it hard and smashes it through covers for another boundary.
Fuller, on the stumps, Kyle Coetzer looks to go hard at it. Gets the inside half of his blade towards mid-wicket.
SIX! Short and punished! Fayyaz Butt bangs this short around off, Kyle Coetzer gets back and pulls it mightily over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Fuller, outside off, Kyle Coetzer hits it aerially towards deep extra cover and gets a couple.
Back of a length, around leg, Matthew Cross pulls it away to fine leg for a single.
Full, outside off, Cross pushes it to the short cover fielder.

SIX! Dispatched! Flighted one, full and around off, Kyle Coetzer steps back to make room and launches it handsomely over wide long off. Onto the roof. At the end of the Powerplay, Scotland are 45/1, needing 78 more off 84 balls.
Arm ball, around middle and skidding down, Cross nurdles it behind square leg for one.
Quicker again, around middle, Matthew Cross stays back and pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Kyle forces it down to long on for a single.
Floated one, full and around off, Kyle Coetzer plays a delightful inside-out shot over extra cover. The fielder chases it down near the fence and the batsmen take a couple.
Wide! Fires a short ball down the leg side, Kyle Coetzer tries to pull but misses. The keeper does well to get his body behind it and stops the ball.
Flighted delivery, full and on middle, it's knocked down to long on for a single. Cross is off the mark.
The skipper, Zeeshan Maqsood brings himself into the attack now.
Swing and a miss! Effort ball from Fayyaz Butt. He bends his back to hurl across a spicy short ball around off, Kyle stays back to pull but it bounces over his bat. End of a successful over.
Attempts a yorker to surprise the batsman but it turns out to be a full toss, Kyle Coetzer hits it back to the bowler on one bounce.
Matthew Cross is in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fayyaz Butt digs it in short, around off, George Munsey turns inside the crease and pulls it aerially over square leg. He gets the timing right but there is no elevation behind his aerial attempt. It goes flat and straight to the fielder in the deep and Jatinder Singh takes the catch easily. Can Oman build on this wicket? 90 runs needed in 92 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Jatinder Singh b Fayyaz Butt

Commentary.Commentary: Sharp delivery, full and angling in from around off, Munsey defends it to the off side.
FOUR! It's a great shot! Back of a length, around off and angling in, George Munsey is on his toes as he cracks it through the gap at cover-point for a boundary.
Fayyaz Butt (1-0-8-0) comes from the opposite end now.

Fuller in length and around off, Kyle Coetzer drives it to the right of the cover fielder and rushes across to the other end. Jatinder Singh fumbles while picking up the ball and makes that run easy for the batters.
Slower again, full and on off, it's pushed back to the bowler to end the over, two boundaries from it.
Loopy and full around off, it's defended back off the front foot.
FOUR! Well played! Quicker one again, full and around off, George Munsey brings out the reverse-batted shot from his repertoire and nails it behind backward point for a boundary.
Flatter and fuller on off, defended from the crease to the off side.
Short again, around off, Munsey cuts it from the back foot but finds the cover fielder.
FOUR! Slapped away! That's a poor length to begin a spell. Short and wide outside off, George Munsey rocks back and shows no mercy as he smacks it through cover-point.
Here comes the first bowling change. Aqib Ilyas comes into the attack.

FOUR! Up and over the fielder inside the ring. Bilal Khan speeds in and serves it on a shortish length around off, Kyle Coetzer takes the aerial route and just manages to send it over the leaping mid off fielder. A boundary to end the over, 9 from it!
Fuller one, around off, George Munsey drives it off the inner half towards the right of mid on. They steal a quick run as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Bouncer around middle and leg, George Munsey decides not to pull it and ducks.
One more dot. Bilal delivers it on a good length around off, George stays back and pushes it towards the bowler.
Better length this time, very full and around off, slower in pace, Munsey brings his bat down in time as he pushes it out to mid off.
FOUR! Easy pickings. That's not the length Bilal Khan is known for. Short and wide outside off, George Munsey camps back and whacks it through point for a boundary.
Shortish and around off, at 131 kph and it skids off the surface, Kyle Coetzer tries to pull but it takes the top half of his bat and rolls towards mid on.

Caught off a Free Hit! Fayyaz Butt hurls it on a fuller length and outside off, George Munsey goes hard at it and gets a lot of height on his attempted inside-out shot. Jatinder Singh catches the ball at cover-point and has an immediate shy at the bowler's end. Misses. One run added to the total.
Wide! Short and way wide outside off, the batter leaves it alone. Free Hit stays...

Fayyaz Butt bowls it on a fuller length around middle, Kyle Coetzer digs it out and it bounces over the head of his partner at the other end. The mid on fielder cuts it off and they cross. Called a no ball as Fayyaz Butt has overstepped. Free Hit coming up...
Angling down the leg side, fuller in length, it's clipped behind square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around leg, Kyle plays a mistimed pull shot in front of square leg for one.
Play and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Kyle swings massively at it but misses.
This is the equation. Oman will have to restrict Scotland to 120 or less to boost their NRR and qualify for the Super 12.
Short in length and around off, Kyle Coetzer hangs back and drags his pull shot over mid-wicket for a couple.
Fayyaz Butt to steam in from the other end.
A yorker around off, Kyle Coetzer squeezes it out down to third man for a single.
Beaten this time! Bilal Khan serves it on a length around off, it nips around after hitting the deck, Kyle Coetzer pushes inside the line and misses.
Around off on a fuller length, angling away, Kyle Coetzer plays a mistimed off drive to mid off.
Excellent fielding! Bilal pitches it up and around off, George pushes it to the right of mid off. Zeeshan Maqsood dives there to make a partial stop and Munsey takes a single to open his account.
On a length and close to off, shaping away a bit, George Munsey stays on the back foot and plays it down to covers.
Delivers it full and around off, Munsey drives it down the ground but finds mid off.
Wide! Wrong line from Bilal Khan to begin proceedings. Sliding down the leg side, on a length, George Munsey tries his best to flick but misses.
